description: Harbor's swagger omits errors its handlers return (goharbor/harbor v2.15.4, read 2026-11-01). GetProject declares only 200/401/500, but src/server/v2.0/handler/project.go returns RequireProjectAccess's 403 and SendError's 404 from projectCtl.Get. ListRobot declares no 403, but src/server/v2.0/handler/robot.go calls requireAccess, which returns errors.ForbiddenError. CreateRobot declares no 409, but src/pkg/robot/dao/dao.go maps a duplicate name to orm.WrapConflictError. Type them with the model's status errors so callers can tell a missing project or a name race from other failures.
